attempted_axis: Run-56 TOOL lane: nine queue items against tools/gdl + memory_graph, each observation reproduced with the reporter's own command BEFORE any cure was designed, each new screen calibrated two-sided (positives AND negatives counted), one commit per item.

attributes.law_screen: core-screen fetched in one call (`laws --tag core-screen`, 54 laws). None of the de-fakematch conversion laws applies: this lane made no source conversion and no member retype. The GOVERNING laws are the workflow ones and they were applied: claim.law.T7_a-queue-items-stated-symptom-is-a-hypothesis-and-three-of-eleven-were-wrong-in-different-ways.20260902.v1 (two of nine items did not reproduce as stated), AGENTS.md's two-sided calibration rule (every shipped screen carries both counts), discipline 18's what-else-has-this-shape screen (run on items 3, 5, 6, 7 and 8), and discipline 19's quote-the-query rule (used for all three absence claims below).
attributes.residual: TWO OBSERVATIONS DID NOT REPRODUCE, both recorded as deliverables. (1) Item 1: `python memory_graph/gdlmem.py build` exits 0 in this worker session, so the reported permission-classifier block is a property of the REPORTER's session, not of the repository; the contract gap was real and the fallback is now documented and self-describing. (2) Item 2: `gdlmem find --tu` is NOT silent about truncation -- it has published `truncated: true` and a warning naming the limit since 3d5347184 (2026-08-31), three days before the report. Censusing the eleven limit-bearing surfaces instead found the class two surfaces away: `search` and `tool` both cut and said nothing, and `search` is the surface AGENTS.md's absence rule points lanes at. Item 6's reported instance also does not reproduce (0 of 76 WRONG-POOL-VALUE rows are relocation tables at HEAD) while its mechanism is real and now guarded. TWO DESIGN REVERSALS, both forced by calibration: the denial screen's first cut matched phrases and reported NO CONTRADICTION on its own seed case (DECL-ORDER vs DECLARATION ORDER), and item 6's obvious cure -- calling the existing `is_pointer_table` from `pool_row_findings` -- would have hidden a genuine f64 0.0-vs-30.0 constant defect, which is why the shipped discriminant reads the relocation table instead. THREE ABSENCE CLAIMS, each with its query: no tool named for denial contradictions (`Get-ChildItem tools/gdl,tools/gdl/composed_census -Filter *.py -Name | Select-String 'denial|contradict'` -> empty) ; no record carries GC's scratchpad-glob numbers (`gdlmem search "388"` -> 13 records, all about instruction offsets; `search "scratchpad glob foreign claims stale drafts"` -> only the work_claim); no record carries the name-files-not-families lesson (`gdlmem search "name files not families"` -> 5 records, none about ownership). HANDED OFF TO WF, not fixed (webfrank.py is WF's file this run): a refusal from a multi-window rule names no window. All 11 `raise ValueError` sites inside `permute_instruction_atoms` carry a bare message and 0 of them name the window, the function or the unit, while 13 of 162 shipped rules are multi-window (11 with two windows, 2 with three: atree::fn_8001267C, combat::CameraSupervisor, mb_camera::MBCameraUpdate and MBWorldToScreen3D, pb_diag::pbDiagDrawSoundRow and pbDiagDrawMenu, pb_texture::pbInitTlutRegions, pb_window::pbWinSetup and pbProjCalc, memcard::buildSaveImage and init_all_dir_info, sysservice::sysResetService, world/camera::camera_mode_level). The cure is two `try/except ValueError` wrappers around the `zip(windows, ranges)` loops at webfrank.py:4014 and :4589, re-raising as `f"{symbol.name}: permutation window {i} of {len(windows)} [+0x{relative_start:x}..+0x{relative_end:x}]: {error}"`.

hypothesis.cheapest_refuting_observation: Run one of them (e.g. wf_mkrule.py or cn_derive.py) on a function whose rule is in the 59-rule DEGRADE set, with and without the image, and compare the authored rule. If the rule is identical, the debt is cosmetic for that tool and it can be moved to CLEAN cheaply.
hypothesis.count_consequence: count-neutral by construction: nothing here touches an instruction stream.
hypothesis.prescription: Pass `wf.RetailImage(orig/GUNE5D/sys/main.dol)` as apply_patch's fifth argument and REFUSE (SystemExit) when it is absent, exactly as wr_try_rule.py and ha_close.py now do; then remove the file from KNOWN_DEBT in t26_apply_patch_image_audit.py, which the suite pins.
hypothesis.screened_against_target: no -- this is a tool-proof-strength question measured against config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json's shipped rules and the raw .postprocess/body objects, not against target bytes.
hypothesis.statement: The 22 remaining image-less `apply_patch` call sites (item 7) each prove rules with the datum screen at L4, and 36% of the shipped corpus measurably degrades at that strength. They are declared debt rather than fixed because they belong to several lanes' derivation workflows and a blind edit to a rule-authoring path should be made by someone reading its output.
